record_scope_reconstruction: La Amistad bridge at El Amatillo was obstructed by Honduran protesters in the dated 22 December 2017 report. Separate El Poy warning is not merged.

source_checks.finding: El Salvador Times 22 December cites migration warning that protesters blocked entry to Honduras at La Amistad; police intervention did not establish exact first normal passage.

sites.name: El Amatillo, La Amistad bridge customs approach
sites.coordinate_method: DMS conversion of official Honduran customs site coordinates, corroborated with OSM-derived customs point
sites.precision: approximate bridge approach; exact 2017 protest footprint unlocated
sites.evidence_note: Honduran customs procurement specifies Amatillo Puente La Amistad TIM Salida coordinates 13°35′33.3″N 87°45′56.1″W. OSM named El Amatillo customs office N5560746139 is within 25 m. This is the bridge approach customs reference, not a surveyed barrier or bridge centre.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Officially georeferenced La Amistad customs approach; actual bridge obstruction footprint unresolved.
phase_decisions.date_scope_check: Missing onset stays missing; 22 December evidence/endpoint interpretation retained without inventing start.

independence_note: Pass B reconstructed from original cited-source access and attributable geographical evidence; no pass-A findings read.
